findings.violated_expectation: Approved shared configuration/project-resolution/resource-bound contract as detailed in original report.
findings.consequence: Reviewer claims practical CPU/memory/IO exhaustion despite pass timeout.
findings.disposition_reason: Parent adjudication: positive finite caller-selected max_sessions/max_source_bytes already provide per-pass bounds, with a separate subprocess deadline. An additional product-wide practical ceiling may be useful hardening but is not an agreed requirement; arbitrarily choosing one is not necessary to satisfy configured bounds. Original CHANGES_REQUESTED report remains intact.
